scope: All 79 League starting kits; evolved forms belong to their original partner
basis: Editorial Classic opening-comfort model. No measured DPS or win-rate claim. Player board includes all 151 species.

method.description: Comfort combines relative baseline HP (55%), armor (20%) and regen (25%), then curated recovery, defense and control bonuses with a setup penalty. Pressure uses the stronger physical/special baseline percentile plus an editorial offensive-kit bonus. Utility rewards recovery, protection and control. Scores compare openings, not endgame damage.
limitations: Baselines exclude passive modifiers, Lab, vitamins, items and enemy resistances.
Passive bonuses are editorial judgments, not measured effect sizes.
Attack geometry, targeting, status immunity and late-run scaling can reverse an ordering.
Non-evolving partners also receive growth; they are not penalized for lacking evolution.
A later patch may alter these versioned kits.
